hero.eyebrow: Micro-label above main heading (e.g., 'The architecture behind grounded AI'). Max 6 words.

h1.h1-text: Primary concept / service title prefix (e.g., 'RAG development services: what retrieval-augmented generation is,').
h1.span: Value proposition or deliverable suffix (e.g., 'and how I build it'). Max 6 words.

hero.hero-sub: Introductory paragraph defining the core technology concept, why grounded AI matters over guessing from general training, and full lifecycle engineering scope. Exactly 2-3 sentences.

cred.b: Cred highlight text (e.g., '5+ yrs production RAG', '60–80% less hallucination', '48h written spec'). Max 5 words.

btn-primary.text: Action-oriented primary CTA button text (e.g., 'Talk to a RAG developer'). Max 4-5 words.

btn-ghost.text: Secondary ghost CTA button text (e.g., 'View case studies'). Max 4 words.

hero.live: Trust statement guaranteeing source traceability and guardrail design from day one. Exactly 1 sentence.

trust.span: Metric explanation (e.g., 'Years building production RAG', 'Peak hallucination reduction', 'From call to written spec'). Max 5 words.
